function: DDPG jointly sets device transmit powers and IRS phase shifts to maximize the minimum secrecy rate of NOMA uplink model uploading against an eavesdropper (pp. 4-6).
system: BS with 4 or 10 antennas, 4 or 10 single-antenna devices, one single-antenna eavesdropper, reflecting IRS with 4-40 passive elements; band not stated (pp. 3, 8-9).
method: DDPG actor-critic DRL, fully connected networks with two hidden layers, whitening, batch normalization, Adam; trained by agent-environment interaction on simulated channels (pp. 5-6).
data_channel: Simulated log-distance path loss with Rayleigh fading; devices within 50 m of the BS, Eve within 50 m of the IRS, random positions (pp. 3-4, 7).
test_conditions: Training and evaluation in the same simulated environment; results swept over maximum power, IRS elements, devices, antennas and IRS-device path loss; no unseen-condition test reported (pp. 7-9).
baselines: Non-learned only: FL without IRS and FL with random IRS phase shift; no learned baseline compared (p. 7).
metrics: Minimum secrecy rate in bps/Hz versus transmit power, IRS elements, devices, antennas and IRS-device path loss exponent; training reward curves (pp. 7-9).
complexity: Order O(sum over layers of Ds Da) for the four-layer actor network; no runtime or parameter count reported (p. 7).
q1_support: p. 4: "The small-scale fading adopts the Rayleigh fading model". Missing: custom log-distance path loss with Rayleigh fading; no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 8: "We further investigate the effect of the transmission power on the minimum secrecy rate under two different system settings". Missing: no policy trained in one setting is tested in another; state and action sizes depend on NT, Nd and NI (p. 6), and no adaptation or transfer is reported.
q3_support: p. 7: "we compare our algorithm with two benchmark schemes: 1) FL without IRS, and 2) FL with random IRS phase shift". Missing: no earlier learned method or other learning algorithm (for example DQN) is compared; p. 4 only argues that Deep Q Learning is inadequate.
q4_support: p. 7: "the time complexity of a linear layer can be calculated as" O(Ds Da); the overall order is the sum of this over the four layers.
q5_support: p. 7: "The devices and the Eve are randomly distributed within circles of radius 50 m". Missing: no code or data link, public dataset or measured channels; all channels are simulated.
notes: Area 3: the DDPG agent sets the IRS phase shifts and device power for the secrecy rate. The uplink is NOMA with SIC decoding and FedAvg at the BS (pp. 3-4), not over-the-air computation, and the paper contrasts itself with OTA (p. 2), so area 7 does not apply. No FL training results are reported, only secrecy rate and DDPG reward curves. Baselines are non-learned only, so q3 is 0. Table I and Figs. 3 to 8 were checked on the page images.
